name: TC-1410: 25 h at A + 25 h at B = 10 h overtime, all on B's timecard
description: Linked person, one workweek: A (worked first) shows 25 h regular, 0 overtime and only its own three shifts; B shows 15 h regular, 10 h overtime and a $150.00 premium (10 h × 0.5 × $30.00).
